title: 3-Phase BL0906 Energy Metering Schematic
desc:
I need a complete schematic that lets the BL0906 energy-meter IC into a three-phase design and talk to it through a standalone STM32F103CBT6. The STM32 only has one job: grab raw registers from the BL0906, crunch RMS voltage and current, active power, active energy, fault flags and line frequency, then pass the results to my main controller (an ESP32) over SPI, which is the fixed interface for this project.

Key electrical details
• Current input must accept either conventional CTs or voltage-output sensors through a jumper-selectable.
• Voltage sensing is handled by a ZMPT101B module.  
• I want a well-calibrated passive filter stage on every phase to tame mains transients and high-frequency noise before they reach the BL0906. Keep the cut-off practical for 50/60 Hz metering accuracy while giving good surge immunity.
• Calibration option required for accuracy.

What I expect from you
• A clear, production-ready schematic (PDF + editable file in KiCad ).  
• Annotated BOM with part numbers that are easy to source.  
• Brief design notes explaining CT burden selection, jumper logic and the passive filter design so I can tweak values if my sensor mix changes later.

title: Open  Textbook
desc:

Accuracy, pedagogical clarity, and consistent tone are essential throughout.

After the manuscript is complete, the work extends to page design and accessibility: clean, responsive typography, navigable headings, alt-text on every figure, and a hyperlinked table of contents. Deliverables  
• Structured manuscript with all chapters, end-of-chapter problems, and answer key  
• Source files for text, images, and diagrams, clearly organised for future updates  
• Styled templates or CSS/TeX files that generate identical page numbers across formats  
• Final PDF, ePub, and print-ready files that pass accessibility checkers (e.g., EPUBCheck, PAC 3)  
• A brief build guide so the files can be regenerated by any instructor in the future

Acceptance criteria  
1. Content free of factual errors, plagiarism, and non-licensed assets  
2. Readability score appropriate to the agreed academic level  
3. All links, cross-references, and index entries resolve correctly in each format

The content must help travellers visualise the experience, plan their day, and feel confident about everything from transport to ticket windows.  

Articles should:  
• Run 1,200–1,500 words each, written in clear, engaging English.  
• Blend captivating storytelling with concrete details such as entry fees, opening hours, peak vs. off-peak tips, recommended photo spots, and local etiquette.  
• Follow on-page SEO best practices—keyword-rich headings, a succinct meta description, and internal link suggestions.  
• Close with a concise day-plan or walking route so the reader can act immediately on the advice given.  

Deliverables  
1. Eight original blog articles & guides in Google Docs or Word format.  
2. A short keyword list for every article.  
3. Royalty-free images (or clearly marked image placement notes) that complement each guide.  

Acceptance criteria  
– 100 % original, plagiarism-free writing.  
– All facts cross-checked against reliable sources published within the past 18 months.  
– Consistent tone and formatting across every article.  

Feel free to pick destinations nationwide; I’m open to everything from Jaipur’s palaces to Kerala’s backwaters, provided each piece focuses on memorable sightseeing and practical takeaways for a curious traveller.

title: Somali to English Translation -- 2
desc:
I need a fluent Somali-to-English translator to render a text I currently have in Somali into clear, naturally flowing English. Please keep the original meaning, tone, and any culturally specific references intact, while correcting obvious spelling or grammatical slips that might appear in the source.

Turn-around speed and accuracy will guide my hiring decision; if you can deliver within 24 hours, mention that in your bid.

title: Farmhouse Survey and Rustic 3D Design
desc:

Start with an on-site measurement survey. I need precise As-Built drawings in AutoCAD showing every wall, opening, floor-to-ceiling height, beam, column, and every existing electrical or plumbing point. Accuracy here is critical, as all later work hinges on these files.

Phase 2 – Concept to Photoreal  
Using the verified plans, develop detailed 2D layouts and furniture planning for the interiors, the detached gazebo, and the complete landscape. Photorealistic 3D renders are required for all three areas so I can visualise the final look before sign-off. The aesthetic is a premium rustic farmhouse: think warm natural finishes, exposed timber, and especially traditional hand-carved teak furniture anchoring the interiors.

Phase 3 – Build-Ready Documentation  
Translate the approved design into working drawings—joinery details, reflected ceiling plans, electrical & plumbing overlays, landscape hardscape/softscape sheets, and a material specification schedule. Everything should be ready for local craftsmen and contractors to price and execute without guesswork.

To move forward, please share:  
• A portfolio link highlighting similar rustic or farmhouse work  
• Your fixed design-only fee or a milestone breakdown  
• What you include in the deliverable set (drawings, renders, material boar

title: Part-Time Accountant with Excel Proficiency
desc:
I’m looking for a reliable accountant to step in on a part-time basis and keep my books clean and my numbers clear. Your core focus will be straightforward bookkeeping in QuickBooks and preparing concise financial reports. Excel will mainly be used for tidy data entry, basic formulas, and simple summaries that feed those reports—no macros or VBA required.

Typical rhythm: record and reconcile transactions in QuickBooks a few times each week, then turn that data into monthly P&L and balance-sheet snapshots in Excel. Because the workload is light and predictable, hours can be flexible as long as deadlines are met and statements stay current.

Key deliverables
• QuickBooks file kept fully up to date  
• Monthly financial statements exported or recreated in Excel using basic formulas  
• Clear, well-labeled Excel sheets that I can review at a glance  

If you have solid accounting fundamentals, comfort with QuickBooks, and attention to detail in Excel, let’s talk.

title: Excel Text Reformat Update
desc:
I have a single Excel workbook containing between 100 – 500 rows of pure text data that needs a clean, consistent look. Your task is to open the file and manually re-format every entry—nothing numerical or date related, just the words themselves.

Once I share the style guide you will:
• apply the agreed capitalisation (e.g., Title Case or sentence case),
• trim extra spaces or line breaks,
• ensure punctuation is consistent, and
• keep each record in its original row so formulas and references stay intact.

No automated global replace, please—each cell should be reviewed by eye to avoid accidental changes.

Deliverables
1. The updated Excel file with all text entries formatted to spec.
2. A brief “before vs after” sheet or note highlighting any non-obvious adjustments you made.

If you work comfortably with Excel tools such as Find/Replace, PROPER, TRIM, and basic filters, this will be a quick, tidy project. I’m ready to send the file and style guide as soon as you’re available.

desc:

The ultimate purpose of this traffic is to showcase and move a physical product, so the viewers have to be real people located in the United States who are likely buyers, not just vanity numbers.

I am only interested in organic-style tactics—smart hashtag strategies, cross-account collaborations, share-worthy caption hooks, maybe niche community engagement—anything that drives genuine U.S. users to tap and watch. No paid ads or automated bot networks, and no influencer shout-outs unless they fit naturally into an organic collaboration plan.

You should be able to:

• Maintain or improve engagement metrics (watch time, likes, saves, comments) so the account’s health stays strong.

If you already have proven tactics or a network that reliably funnels real American viewers, tell me how long it will take to ramp up, how you verify audience location, and how you’ll keep performance steady without violating Instagram’s terms. title: Commercial Site & Parking Plan
desc:
I’m preparing a commercial project for local authority review and need a complete site plan that also resolves all parking requirements. The drawing must be accurate enough for permitting, showing property boundaries, building footprints, circulation lanes, accessible spaces, counts that satisfy code, and any setbacks, easements or right-of-way lines that affect layout.

Please base the work on the latest survey information (to be supplied as a PDF and DWG) and draft the plan in AutoCAD or compatible software so revisions remain straightforward. Final files should include:

title: Pre-Employment Vetting Project, Parma - Italy
desc:
For a hiring decision I am currently verifying a candidate’s academic background obtained in Parma, Italy. The task centres on an education verification only, no employment or reference checks are required.

Scope of work  
– Confirm the candidate actually earned the stated qualification at the indicated institution in Parma.  
– Obtain authoritative proof directly from the registrar or designated office (email confirmation, stamped letter, or online registry extract).  
– Record key details normally included in an education screen—degree name, field of study, graduation date and the institution’s official accreditation status—so the final report can be accepted by any international compliance team.

I will supply the candidate-signed consent form and their declared qualification details once we start. You would contact the school, follow up as needed (Italian language expected), and compile a concise verification report with supporting evidence.

Deliverables  
• Brief narrative report (PDF or Word) summarising findings  
• Copy of primary evidence (official email trail, letterhead, or registry screenshot)  
• Your confirmation that all information was obtained directly from the institution

The assignment is complete once I receive the report and evidence that clearly confirms or refutes the claimed credential.

title: US Individual Tax Preparation
desc:
I’m looking for a seasoned U.S. tax professional to take full responsibility for preparing my individual tax return this year. Accuracy and timeliness matter to me more than anything, so I’d like you to handle every step of the preparation process—from organizing the source documents through to producing a ready-to-file return that meets all IRS requirements.

Here’s what you’ll be doing for me:  
• Gather and reconcile the income, deduction, and credit information I provide (W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, receipts, etc.).  
• Prepare the complete individual return in standard IRS format, using professional software such as UltraTax, Drake, or similar.  
• Flag any red-flags or missed opportunities for deductions or credits and give quick recommendations before finalizing.  
• Deliver a PDF copy of the completed return plus the corresponding e-file data set so I can submit immediately.

Acceptance criteria  
– All figures tie back to the source documents I supply; no unexplained variances.  
– Return passes your software’s built-in diagnostics with no critical errors.  
– I receive the finished package at least three business days before the filing deadline.

If you have prior experience with complex income streams, state add-ons, or multi-form schedules, that’s a definite plus—I may need that expertise as my situation evolves.

title: Zero-Downtime Docker Swarm Cluster
desc:
I need a production-ready Docker Swarm cluster deployed on multiple Contabo VPS nodes. Each service must run with at least two replicas so traffic can shift seamlessly during updates; downtime is not acceptable.  

What I expect:  
• A fully automated bootstrap script or Ansible/Terraform playbook that provisions the manager and worker nodes on my Contabo instances.  
• An opinionated but maintainable overlay network, encrypted in-flight, with service discovery and automatic rescheduling of failed containers.  
• Blue/green or rolling update workflow wired into a simple CI/CD step (GitHub Actions is fine) that can automatically roll back if a health-check or readiness probe fails.  
• Centralised logging plus real-time monitoring and alerting—Prometheus + Grafana or another open-source stack that gives me CPU, memory, container health, and custom app metrics with email/Slack alerts.  
• Brief but clear documentation that lets me add new nodes or services without breaking the cluster.

SSH access to freshly installed Ubuntu servers is ready; root or sudo privileges are available. I’ll test the setup by pushing an example image and performing a forced failure—if traffic keeps flowing and the rollback triggers correctly, we’re good.

title: Ark: Ascended Item Dupe

Deliverables: a document containing 25 freshly written, short love shayari, ready for me to review and publish. I’ll check the flow, emotion, and originality with plagiarism tools before releasing payment.

If you’re comfortable writing in clean Devanagari script and can capture that gentle, romantic pulse, let’s get started.
